text:
maria: Vendor just flagged 20 H100s on hold — AWB 123-45678901. They claim a firmware/serial sticker mismatch detected during EU preflight. They attached a short QC note below. We need triage on replacement vs. reflash.
vendor: "Hold reason: 20 units show serials with firmware build older than expected and an incompatible sticker batch (shelf-life mismatch). Customs may reject unless we provide traceable firmware records or swap units. Will hold at FRA depot pending instruction."
maria: I've asked for exact serial list. Posting it when I get it.
jamal: If it's firmware-only, can we reflash and get customs docs? Or do vendors require warranty swap? What's vendor proposing for RMA/credit? :thinking_face:
maria: Vendor replied — they want a depot RMA for replacements. They claim flashing at the depot is not allowed due to sealed warranty. They're offering replacement units with a lead time of 10-14 days or credit for delayed provisioning.
lee: We have ~8 H100s in the EU warm pool that could cover critical lanes for ~1 week. If we reassign those, we can buy time for the 20 replacements. Would need ops to move capacity and update routing rules.
sophia: Forwarder options: (1) expedite sea->air for the replacement (expedite adds ~€1.2k per unit), (2) consolidate to next day air for subsets. Also need correct HS code for customs to avoid extra hold: use 8542.31.90. Suggest we push vendor to absorb expedite surcharge if it's their QC.
maria: Good — can ops handle reassign? @lee please confirm. Also jamal, vendor credit vs absorb expedite cost decision?
lee: Can do a temporary pool move for 8 units — will schedule a 2hr maintenance window during low traffic. Need list of endpoints to re-route and owners notified.
jamal: We should negotiate: request vendor cover half of expedite surcharge and provide a 5% off invoice for the delayed 14-day window. If they refuse, accept replacement and we eat expedite for critical lanes only.
rma-bot: RMA created: #RMA-87912. Vendor ETA for replacements: 14 days. Depot hold location: FRA-DEPOT-7. Case owner: jamal.

lee: Thanks — I'll map the 8 units we can move and DM owners. Need the list of endpoints from maria.
maria: Endpoints: eu-west-1-dedicated-pool-a (latency-critical for customer X), eu-central-batch-queue (non-critical), eu-west-2-experiments. I'll DM owners now.
sophia: I asked forwarder to confirm expedite cost and to block shipment until vendor confirms surcharge share. Awaiting their quote.
jamal: I'll push vendor: ask them to 1) waive depot expedite fee, 2) provide replacements under RMA at no extra cost, or 3) else give prorated credit. I'll update thread.
maria: Plan summary: 1) Move 8 warm-pool H100s to cover critical workloads (lee) 2) Jamal to negotiate vendor cost-sharing/credit 3) Sophia to get forwarder expedite quote 4) RMA-87912 open and tracking (rma-bot). Target: minimize user impact, avoid full re-procurement.
lee: On it. I'll post confirmation once routes updated. :rocket:
jamal: Vendor counters: they'll cover 50% of expedite surcharge and ship replacements under standard RMA in 12 days if we accept 50% expedite. They offered 3% credit if we decline expedite. Negotiating now.
maria: Good progress. Keep updates short here. If vendor agrees to 50% expedite we'll approve critical lane air for up to 6 units. Anything else urgent?
sophia: forwarder quote in: expedite air for 6 units = €7,200 total (~€1.2k/unit). If vendor covers 50% we pay €600/unit for 6 units = €3,600. Confirming customs docs checklist now.
jamal: I'll accept vendor 50% share for up to 6 units. Maria, approve so I can close negotiation.
maria: Approving 50% for up to 6 critical units. Proceed. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
